_about: Hard CPU settings. 'value' = how much the CPU cares about each unit. 'weights' score single moves. 'look_ahead': before acting, Hard tries this many marches / vehicle buys / soldier placement plans on private copies of the board, each 'tries' times, playing out its attacks and the enemy's reply; 'eval' scores the board it ends up with. More marches/tries = stronger but slower.
_styles: Ways Hard can play against you. Each changes a few weights/eval numbers above. Against you, Hard picks the styles that have beaten you most often (memory in learned.json). All were tested to be about equally strong.
